provenance_boundary.frozen: taxon-region cohort membership, ACSP plant and animal policies, comparator protocol, Top-k budget, recovery radius, comparator definitions
provenance_boundary.regenerated: GBIF occurrence records, candidate surfaces, and spatial-block holdout assignments on 2026-07-24
provenance_boundary.interpretation: Secondary predeclared reconstruction benchmark. It is not a reanalysis of the exact candidate pools used in the original 2026-07-05/06 confirmatory results and does not replace Table 1.

eligibility_notes: Fulmarus glacialis was ineligible for environmental and dual-space comparisons because the predeclared terrain schema was incomplete across its folds.

Arachniodes rhomboidea had only one evaluable fold in the plant reconstruction; universal methods retained the pair with zero contribution from missing folds, whereas environmental/dual-space comparisons excluded it by the predeclared complete-schema rule.
headline_interpretation: Animal ACSP exceeded same-pool random selection in the reconstruction benchmark, but its incremental difference from local-evidence-only Top-5 was near zero and unresolved.
Pooled plant ACSP is identical to local-evidence-only ranking by design and exceeded same-pool random selection.
ACSP exceeded generic environmental maximin in animals and pooled plants; differences from geographic maximin were not resolved.
The comparator results support focal-taxon local-habitat evidence as the principal validated selection signal and do not establish a general benefit of complementarity itself.
